subject: Stakeholder roster & approval pathway — FinGrowth follow-up
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@fingrowth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder roster & approval pathway — FinGrowth follow-up

Hi Amit — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can map the buying path and get procurement looped in: 

- Recap: FinGrowth is evaluating a dedicated inference lane for your real-time risk-scoring use case (avg. seq len ~128, spiky throughput M-F). You called out reliability and audit logs as must-haves; pricing sensitivity starts at the unit-cost-per-1M tokens level.
- Immediate asks: could you send a one-page org/roster that shows the economic buyer, procurement contact, and who owns security/compliance/legal for AI/infra decisions? Also helpful: any internal decision criteria or must-have checklist for vendor approval.

I pasted a short suggested attendee list below that we can use if you want me to draft intros: 
- Economic buyer / Budget owner
- Procurement / Vendor ops
- Security / Infosec review owner
- Legal (commercial + data privacy)
- Platform engineering / SRE owner (integration point)

Next steps I propose: 
1) You share the roster/org snapshot;
2) We schedule a 30-min procurement + security sync (we'll bring our security lead);
3) We drop a simple SOW + Appendix for SOC2 and data handling for review.

I attached a short 1-pager we usually share that summarizes typical approval lanes ("Redwood-approval-path-cheatsheet.pdf") — should help you map internal roles quickly. Happy to adjust if you have a different process.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

---

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@fingrowth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rodriguez <elena@fingrowth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder roster & approval pathway — FinGrowth follow-up

Hi Soojin — thanks for the recap and the one-pager, useful. Attaching an internal org snapshot (see FinGrowth_org_chart_v2.pdf) — note the labels are approximate.

Quick answers: 
- Economic buyer: Priya Menon (Head of Platform, listed on page 1)
- Procurement contact: procurement@fingrowth.com (cc'd to this thread)
- Security/compliance: Elena will own the initial review and coordinate with our legal team for contract language.

Decision criteria we care about (short list):
1) Latency at p50/p95 under our test profile;
2) Auditability / access logs retention;
3) Cost predictability under spiky workloads;
4) Liability / indemnity language for model outputs (legal to confirm).

We can do a procurement + security sync Wed 11/11 10am PT or Thu 11/12 9am PT — either works for the team.

Best,
Amit
Amit Shah
Senior PM, Risk Platform | FinGrowth Capital
amit.shah@fingrowth.com

Attachment: FinGrowth_org_chart_v2.pdf (1 page stub)

---

From: Procurement Team <procurement@fingrowth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@fingrowth.com>
Cc: Elena Rodriguez <elena@fingrowth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder roster & approval pathway — FinGrowth follow-up

Hi all — adding procurement context. For vendor selection we need: 
- Standard W-9 and Vendor setup form (we'll handle once commercial terms are near-final).
- Completed security questionnaire (we'll send our standard template).
- High level SOW and indicative pricing.

We use DocuSign for initial NDAs and then our procurement portal for purchase orders. If Redwood has a procurement portal or vendor portal link, share that.

Proposed timeline: procurement review within 5 business days of receiving the security questionnaire + SOW.

Procurement Team
procurement@fingrowth.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder roster & approval pathway — FinGrowth follow-up

Soojin — good capture. Two small asks from my side: 
1) Loop Dev on the procurement + security sync so he can bring the SOC2 evidence and our standard answers to the questionnaire; he should also prep the architecture diagram showing how KV cache and prefix caching are handled for multi-tenant configs.
2) Ask FinGrowth for the single prioritized decision criteria list (not a long doc) — we want the top 3 items signed off by Priya if possible. That makes tradeoff conversations much faster.

I'll draft a short email template you can use to introduce Dev to FinGrowth's security contact.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@fingrowth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@fingrowth.com>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@fingrowth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, "FinGrowth Legal" <legal@fingrowth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Stakeholder roster & approval pathway — FinGrowth follow-up

Thanks — this is excellent and very actionable. Confirming next steps below and attachments (Soojin -> Finch):

A) Redwood -> FinGrowth (today):
- Attached: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx (high-level SOW), Redwood-approval-path-cheatsheet.pdf (one-pager)
- I'll also include the W-9 and vendor onboarding link in a follow-up if you need them now.

B) Scheduling:
- We will take Wed 11/11 10am PT for procurement + security sync. Dev (cc'd) will join and bring SOC2 / architecture notes. If the team prefers Thu 11/12 9am PT, say so and we'll move.

C) Action items for FinGrowth: 
- Please confirm Priya Menon as the economic approver or provide the final approver's name/email.
- Share any prioritized top-3 decision criteria (even a one-liner each).
- Legal: if you want us to use your redlines up-front, attach them and we'll have counsel review.

D) Action items for Redwood: 
- Dev to pre-fill the security questionnaire answers and circulate ahead of the sync.
- I'll prepare an SOW appendix for audit logs and retention terms per your notes.

Links & attachments: 
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FG-857
- Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx; Redwood-approval-path-cheatsheet.pdf

If everyone confirms Wed 11/11 10am PT, I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (30 min).

Thanks again — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: 
- Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx (outline of scope, deliverables, pricing ranges)
- Redwood-approval-path-cheatsheet.pdf (one-pager)
